hash_domain: SHA-256 of raw inspected checkout bytes; Git blob line endings can differ; canonical source manifest also records Git blob IDs
scope: tracked app/alembic/scripts Python; tests are indexed in dossier chapter12
method: Python AST declarations/import statements/call expression locations; no code imports or execution
limits: Not a runtime call graph, dispatch order, coverage or reachability proof
Imports can be conditional/inside functions; edges show declarations only
Call receiver/value/alias/shadowing not resolved; dynamic expressions explicitly marked
Decorator/default/annotation calls are syntactic sites too; metadata constructors are not business workflows
Function decorators are visited under the function lexical label; not proof of execution inside that function
No argument literals/default values/function bodies copied into this index
Router prefixes/registration/dependencies must be read with manually traced flow chapters
